name: English

_purpose.week_file: the file name of the weekly report billcall writes into the company's folder; the person sees it in their file list, so it is a plain word in their language
_purpose.week_title: the first heading of that report, read by the person who pays
_purpose.week_this_machine: heading of the part counted from this computer's Claude Code logs at list price
_purpose.week_team: heading of the part read from the organisation's spend-report CSV
_purpose.week_otel: heading of the part read from an OpenTelemetry export; keep the metric name as it is
_purpose.week_idle: heading of the list of paid seats nobody used this week; factual, never blaming
_purpose.guard_head: the budget line at session start; {parts} is the day and month parts joined by commas
_purpose.guard_day: today's part of the budget line; keep {spent}, {budget}, {share}
_purpose.guard_spent: appended when the budget is spent; it also tells Claude to ask the person responsible
_purpose.guard_partial: appended when the log scan stopped at its time limit
_purpose.ratio_headline: the one-line headline under the cheap-class table; keep {low}, {high}, {haiku}, {sonnet}; never present a weaker model as a plain saving
_purpose.ratio_other: one line per other reference model; keep {model} and {range}
_purpose.ratio_conditions: the conditions the ratios hold under; keep {updated}
_purpose.guard_in_seat: the session-start line on a seat (claude_billing seat): in-seat usage is not money; keep {day} and {month}
_purpose.trace_file: the file name of the trace report billcall writes into the company's folder
_purpose.trace_title: the first heading of the trace report: what the agents did and what it cost

week_this_machine: This computer (Claude Code logs, at list price)
guard_head: billcall: AI spend on this computer at list price - {parts}
guard_spent: . The budget is spent: tell the person, and ask the one responsible before going on.
guard_50: . Half of the budget is gone.
guard_partial: (counted from part of the logs: the scan stopped at its time limit)
ratio_headline: Headline: the cheap Chinese models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8-flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, MiMo-v2.6-flash, MiniMax M3) are {low}-{high} times cheaper than Claude per 1M tokens: against Haiku 4.5 {haiku}, against Sonnet 5.5 {sonnet}. Against Sonnet this is a move to a weaker model, not a plain saving.
ratio_conditions: Conditions: list prices of each vendor's own API from data/prices.json ({updated}), per 1M tokens, blended 3 input : 1 output, no cache, no batch; DeepSeek at its peak-hour price; the lowest prompt tier. A ratio above 1 means the Chinese model is cheaper. Quality index: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index as recorded in the row (variants differ: max, high). Tokenizers differ between vendors, so the same text is not the same number of tokens; Claude 5.x counts about 1.3x the tokens of the previous Claude tokenizer (the row's tokenizer_factor), which raises the Sonnet 5.5 ratios by up to 1.3x for the same text. Kimi K2.7-code (Moonshot has no flash-class model) is in the table but not in the headline.
guard_in_seat: billcall: in-seat usage on this computer - today {day}, this month {month} at API list price; inside the seat allowance it is not billed in dollars
